description:
The SunflowerApp project is open in Android Studio. Users have requested the ability to search and filter the plant list. Add a search feature that lets users filter plants by typing a query.

The search should:
- Filter plants by matching against name, description, or grow zone number
- Update the displayed list in real-time as the user types
- Show all plants when the search query is empty
- Be accessible via a search input field in the main activity layout

You need to:
- Add a search input to the layout
- Create a PlantFilter utility class
- Wire up the search logic in MainActivity
- Add appropriate string resources

Login credentials: user 'ga', password 'password123'.

Ensure the project compiles after all changes.
